name: Judgment Day
overview: Judgment Day is a solemn event appointed by God when all people will give an account for their words and actions, as Jesus teaches that every idle word will be judged (Matthew 12:36) and that His own words will serve as the standard of judgment (John 12:48). This day is known only to the Father (Matthew 24:36) and follows the certainty of death (Hebrews 9:27). Believers are reminded that all will stand before the judgment seat of Christ, emphasizing personal responsibility and the ultimate authority of Christ's judgment (Romans 14:10). The imagery of an angel with authority over the abyss in Revelation 20:1 points to the divine power involved in the final judgment.
